title: TrueRise completion report (G35/G36): three-way per-item ledger
description: For EVERY acceptance item of the sealed contract exactly one entry: done (with an evidence reference), not_done (with a reason from the closed taxonomy), or not_verified (with the why and the cost of checking). A report that skips an item is refused - silence is not coverage; a contract under the machine-check floor cannot certify completion at all.

contract_sealed_hash.description: the sealed intent contract hash this report dispositions

entries.description: exactly one done/not_done/not_verified entry per acceptance item (no skips, no duplicates)
